core_principles: Fusion over Imitation: Mix traditional Afghan aesthetics with modern Swiss editorial design.
Emotion First: Evoke the warmth of Afghan hospitality (Mehman Nawazi).
Content is King: Recipes are stories, not just instructions.
Negative Space: Use 'Creme' whitespace to let the colorful food breathe.
anti_patterns: No pure black (#000000) or pure white (#FFFFFF) backgrounds without texture.

usage_rules: Use 'Playfair Display' for all H1, H2, and Hero text.
Use 'Inter' for long-form reading (blog posts, recipe steps).
Use 'Caveat' for 'Chef's Tips', 'Secret Ingredients', or personal notes.

colors.theme_strategy: Light Mode Dominant (Warm/Organic). Dark mode should be deep forest green, not black.
colors.gradients: No gradients. Use solid colors or subtle textures.

visual_enhancers.textures: Subtle grain overlay on the Creme background to simulate paper.
visual_enhancers.decorations: Use Islamic geometric patterns (Girih) as subtle SVG backgrounds in low opacity (5%).

grids.recipe_gallery: Bento Grid: Mix of 2x2 (Hero Dish), 1x1 (Standard), and 1x2 (Vertical) cards.
grids.blog_list: Editorial Layout: Large featured article on left (60%), vertical list of recent posts on right (40%).

layouts.hero: Split screen or Full-width immersive. Image must be high-res. Text overlay must have high contrast.
layouts.recipe_detail: Cookbook Style: Sticky ingredients list on the left. Scrollable instructions on the right. Hero image at the top.

buttons.primary: bg-[#D4A017] hover:bg-[#B88A12] text-white rounded-full px-8 py-3 font-serif text-lg transition-transform hover:scale-105
buttons.secondary: border-2 border-[#1B4D3E] text-[#1B4D3E] hover:bg-[#1B4D3E] hover:text-white rounded-full px-6 py-2 font-sans font-medium

cards.recipe: bg-white rounded-2xl overflow-hidden shadow-sm hover:shadow-md transition-all duration-300 group cursor-pointer

components.inputs: bg-white border-[#D4A017]/30 focus:border-[#D4A017] focus:ring-2 focus:ring-[#D4A017]/20 rounded-lg

motion.scroll: Use 'Lenis' for smooth scrolling if possible. Parallax on Hero images.

accessibility.contrast: Ensure text on Saffron (#D4A017) is White or Dark Green. Text on Creme (#FFF8E7) must be Dark Green (#1B4D3E).
accessibility.testing: All interactive elements MUST have 'data-testid' attribute.

media.image_style: Authentic, warm lighting, high contrast. No sterile studio shots. Food should look 'eaten' or 'ready to eat'.
media.icons: Phosphor Icons (Duotone) or Lucide React (Stroke width 1.5).

hero_kabuli_pulao.alt: Large platter of Kabuli Pulao with carrots and raisins

mantoo_dumplings.alt: Steamed Mantoo dumplings in a pan

instructions_to_main_agent: 2. Configure Tailwind theme with the colors provided above.
3. Create a 'Layout' component that applies the Creme background globally.
4. Build the 'Hero' section using the Kabuli Pulao image and Playfair Display font.
5. Implement the 'RecipeGrid' using the Bento Grid rules.
6. Ensure all buttons and inputs follow the rounded/colored styles defined.
7. Use the provided image URLs for placeholders. DO NOT use generic placeholders.
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: Dark colors look good when used independently without gradients. DO NOT use dark colors as gradients.
Don't make generic centered layouts, simplistic gradients, and uniform styling.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy.
Use glass-morphism effects with backdrop filters (12-24px blur) for sticky headers.
You MUST NOT apply universal transition. Eg: 'transition: all'. This results in breaking transforms.
You MUST NOT center align the app container.
Always use modern button styles like pill-shaped, or sharp button with interaction animations.
NEVER use AI assistant Emoji characters like 🤖🧠 etc for icons.
Every interaction needs micro-animations - hover states, transitions.
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable.
All interactive and key informational elements MUST include 'data-testid' attribute.
